title: Domain Types — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: An area of data a designed report is built on. Part of the report designer carried over from the old system. Not read at present: nothing in HCMv3 runs these definitions, so records here have no effect.

fields.label: Code
fields.rules: Optional. Left blank, the next number is assigned when the record is saved. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html:
What it is. A short code that identifies this item in its list.

Example. 001

fields.label: NameEn
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in English.

fields.label: EntityType
fields.html: What it is. The data it covers.
